stem:
Arun splits a bean seed and counts two seed leaves. The plant later has netted veins on its leaves.

What should he connect?

options.text: Two seed leaves with parallel veins, as if it were a grass.
Two seed leaves (dicot) with netted leaf veins.
Seed-leaf number does not relate to vein pattern, so ignore the seed.
The seed is a monocot because the bean looks round.

teacher.key_rationale: Two cotyledons go with dicot netted veins. Parallel veins are the other seed type. Round shape is not the test.
